blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.
blocks.zh: 世界模式在一个无法充分观察的世界运作。 当一个隐藏的扰动,如水流推船,改变一个动作的结果时,一个反事实问题如下:在不同的动作下会发生什么,受到同样的扰动? 它的答案将坏的决定和坏运气区分开来. 我们证明,接受过事实转变培训的世界模型,无论数据或能力如何,都无法自行应对。 对于许多物理系统来说,观测到的结果和动力学的简单属性就足够了:natura非富含盐,自然不会跳跃. 当动作和扰动作为单独的力量时,它们的相互作用是时间上的第二顺序,所以反事实结果,第一顺序是观测到的结果加上世界模型在另类行动和事实行动下的预测的区别. 这产生了一个反事实世界模型,没有反事实数据,额外参数,也没有再培训. 对于持续时间($h)的过渡,我们证明一个$O(h^2)美元绑定在与扰动差异相对的反事实错误上,从未经证实的事实数据中建立一个匹配的最小值下绑定,并描述不连续时的故障,坐标折叠,以及能够放大命令的扰动。 我们用JEPA的世界模型验证这些像素在冷冻的DINOv2和蒙面自动编码器(MAE)编码器上的预测. 在四个模拟器上,我们的方法使反事实的美元从38美元-46美元提高到86美元-96美元-同一种世界模型;第五个是水下飞行器,它达到90美元-94美元-比16倍的事实数据。 4个进一步的冻结编码器,DINov3,SigLIP~2,CLIP和EVA-02,在同一模拟器上给予81美元-95美元-. 在事后规划中,它发现本来可以达到目标的行动是35美元-69美元-事件,而对于一个知道模拟器但不知道结果的先知规划者来说,行动是14美元-23美元。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
World models predict the consequences of actions and are becoming a core component of agents that interact with the world. From latent dynamics models for control [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 53 , 21 ] to joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) that predict in the feature space of self-supervised encoders [ 28 , 3 , 7 , 4 , 64 , 57 ] ,
they allow agents to anticipate outcomes before acting.
blocks.zh:
世界模型预测行动的后果,并正在成为与世界互动的行动者的核心组成部分。 从潜在的动态模型用于控制[17、18、19、20、53、21]到联合嵌入式预测结构(JEPAs),在自我监督编码器的特征空间中进行预测[28、3、7、4、64、57],
它们允许代理人在采取行动前预期结果。

blocks.en: Yet the real world is never fully observed. Consider the boat of : it picks a heading while an unseen current pushes it. Before acting, no world model can know the current it is about to meet, so the best it can do is predict where the boat ends up on average over currents (green). The observed outcome (diamond) lands elsewhere, and in doing so reveals how far the current actually pushed the boat. A new question then arises: where would the boat have ended up under a different heading, in that same current? (dotted). This is an individual counterfactual . Asked about another heading, a standard world model returns the average over currents again (green) and discards what the outcome revealed. The same question arises whenever a gust of wind or a miscalibrated actuator alters an outcome. Its answer is what one needs to debug a failure, to tell a bad decision from bad luck, to assign credit to an action, and to find in hindsight the action that would have reached the goal, which we call hindsight planning .
blocks.zh: 然而,现实世界从未得到充分观察。 想想这艘船:它挑一个方向,而一个看不见的水流推它。 在行动之前,没有任何世界模型能够知道它即将遇到的海流,所以它所能做的最好就是预测船只平均在海流(绿色)后会到哪里去. 观测到的结果(diamond)在其他地方着陆,从而揭示了水流实际推动船只的程度。 然后又出现了一个新问题:在同一个水流中,该船最终会在哪里处于不同的航向? (点缀). 这是个人反事实 在问到另一个标题时,一个标准的世界模型再次返回平均比电流(绿色),并丢弃结果显示的内容. 当风潮或调节不当的引爆器改变结果时,也会出现同样的问题。 它的答案是人们需要调试一个失败,从坏运气中分辨出一个不好的决定,给一个动作分配功劳,并在事后找到能够达到目标的行动,我们称之为后视规划.

blocks.en: This question is fundamentally different from factual prediction: as we prove, a world model trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on its own. A world model learns the conditional consequences of actions from observed transitions, whereas an individual counterfactual asks about an alternative action under the same hidden disturbance . An unpaired factual dataset does not record outcomes under two actions for the same initial state and realized disturbance. Consequently, even a perfect model of factual transitions does not determine how alternative outcomes are coupled, i.e., which outcome under the alternative action belongs to the observed event: distinct counterfactual worlds can induce exactly the same factual distribution ( and ). Neither a more accurate predictor nor a more expressive generative model resolves this ambiguity, and no factual test can reveal it. Without additional structure, individual counterfactuals are not identified.
blocks.zh: 这个问题与事实预测有着根本的不同:正如我们所证明的那样,一个接受过事实转变训练的世界模型不能单独回答这个问题。 世界模式从观察到的转变中了解到行动的有条件后果,而个人反事实则询问在同一隐蔽扰动下的替代行动。 未经证实的事实数据集没有记录同一初始状态和实际扰动的两个行动的结果。 因此,即使是一个完美的事实转变模式,也不能确定替代结果如何结合,即替代行动下的哪一种结果属于观察到的事件:不同的反事实世界可以诱导完全相同的事实分布(和)。 无论是更准确的预测器还是更表达性的基因模型都不能解决这种模糊性,任何事实测试都无法揭示它. 如果没有额外的结构,个别的反事实是无法识别的.

blocks.en: For many physical systems, nature provides this structure. Natura non facit saltus : nature makes no leaps. When the action and the hidden disturbance enter as separate forces, as the boat’s propulsion and the current do, each changes the state gradually, and each alters the effect of the other only through the change of state it has already caused. Their interaction , i.e., how much the effect of changing the action depends on the disturbance, is therefore second-order in the transition duration. To first order, changing the action changes the outcome by the same amount in every event, and this amount is what a factual world model predicts between the two actions. Separate channels are an assumption on how the disturbance enters, not a consequence of smoothness: a worn actuator whose effect grows with the command is smooth, yet it interacts with the action at first order ( ), and we test this failure in . Under separate channels, this observation leads to a simple construction. Let z t = f ⁡ ( o t ) z_{t}=f(o_{t}) denote the representation of an observation, and let μ ⁡ ( z t , a ) \mu(z_{t},a) be a factual world model trained to predict the next representation under action a a . Given an observed transition ( z t , a t , z t + 1 ) (z_{t},a_{t},z_{t+1}) , we estimate the outcome under an alternative action a ′ a^{\prime} by z ^ t + 1 ​ ( a ′ ) = z t + 1 + μ ⁡ ( z t , a ′ ) − μ ⁡ ( z t , a t ) . \boxed{\widehat{z}_{t+1}(a^{\prime})=z_{t+1}+\mu(z_{t},a^{\prime})-\mu(z_{t},a_{t}).} (1) The observed outcome records the effect of the realized disturbance; the world model predicts the effect of changing the action. The construction requires only two evaluations of an ordinary factual predictor and one residual correction: no paired counterfactual data, additional parameters, explicit disturbance inference, or retraining. We call the resulting predictor a counterfactual world model . On the boat of , it shifts the world model’s prediction for the new heading by the drift that the current caused in the observed event (from the green to the orange outline in the bottom-right frame), and follows the true counterfactual (orange against dotted).
blocks.zh: 对于许多物理系统,自然提供了这种结构. 纳图拉非芳香盐 :自然不会跳跃. 当动作和隐藏的扰动像船的推进和水流一样作为单独的力量进入时,每一次都会逐渐改变状态,每一次只会通过它已经造成的状态变化来改变对方的效果. 因此,它们的相互作用,即改变动作的影响在多大程度上取决于扰动,是过渡期的第二顺序。 首先,改变动作会改变每件事件的结果,结果的金额相同,而这个金额是一个事实世界模型对两种动作之间的预测. 单独的通道是对扰动如何进入的假设,而不是平滑的结果:一个已磨损的振动器,其作用随指令的平滑而增长,然而它与动作在第一顺序( )相互作用,我们测试这种失败在. 在不同的渠道下,这个观察会导致一个简单的构造. 让 z t = f = o t = z = o = o = o = o = o = 表示观测值,让 μ = z t , a )\ mu(z = ),a 成为经过训练的实事求是的世界模型,以预测行动下的下一个表示值 a . 鉴于已观察到的过渡(z t, a t, z t + 1) (z_{t}, a_{t}, z_{t+1}),我们估计了z + 1 (a′t) = z t + 1 + μ  (z t, a′t) → μ⁡(ztt, att) 的替代行动的结果. \ boxed\ glazhat{z}_{t+1}(a^{\prime})=z_{t+1}+\mu(z_{t},a^{\prime})-\mu(z_{t},a_{t})}。} (1)观测结果记录了已实现扰动的影响;世界模型预测了改变作用的影响. 构造只需要对一个普通的事实预测器进行两次评价,并进行一次剩余校正:没有对齐的反事实数据、附加参数、明显的扰动推论或再培训。 我们称由此产生的预测器为反事实世界模型。 它将世界模型对新方向的预测通过观测到的事件引起的漂移(从绿色转向右下方框架的橙色轮廓)来转移,并遵循真实的反事实(与点相对应)。

blocks.en: In additive worlds, residual reuse is the unique counterfactual rule that is exact for every factual transition ( ). Outside this regime, its error is governed by the interaction between actions and hidden disturbances, quantified by the mixed derivative of the dynamics ( ). For short physical transitions with separate action and disturbance channels, this interaction is second-order in the time step h h , leaving only an O ⁡ ( h 2 ) O(h^{2}) fraction of the disturbance uncertainty unexplained ( and ). This guarantee extends through smooth representations and to systems with hidden velocities ( ). The rate cannot be uniformly improved: we establish a matching minimax lower bound, with the sharp leading constant, for estimators using unpaired factual transitions and one observed outcome ( ). Residual reuse therefore achieves the best possible asymptotic rate under the stated information and physical assumptions. How short is short enough depends on the system, and we measure it ( ). The same analysis identifies the limits of residual reuse: disturbances that scale the command, discontinuous contacts, and folded representations can invalidate it.
blocks.zh: 在添加剂世界中,残余再利用是独特的反事实规则,对每一个事实过渡都是准确的(.). 在这个制度之外,它的误差是由动作和隐藏扰动之间的相互作用所决定的,由动力学的混合衍生物量化(.). 对于有单独动作和扰动通道的短暂物理过渡,这种相互作用在时间步 h h 中为第二顺序,只留下O ⁡(h 2) O(h ^{2) 扰动不确定性的一小部分(和 ). 这一保障通过平稳的表示和隐藏速度的系统延伸(.)。 比率不能统一提高:我们为使用未经证实的事实过渡和一种观察到的结果的估算者建立一个匹配的小型下限,并有尖锐的领先常数。 因此,根据所述信息和物理假设,剩余再利用达到尽可能好的不对称率。 短的多短取决于系统,我们测量它(.). 同样的分析还确定了剩余再利用的限度:使指令规模扩大的扰动,不连续的接触,以及折叠的表示可以使其失效.

blocks.en:
Residual correction is familiar in control theory, where disturbance observers, offset-free model predictive control, and iterative learning control reuse errors from observed trajectories [ 39 , 35 , 41 , 2 , 11 ] .
Likewise, additive-noise structural causal models provide a classical route to individual counterfactuals [ 44 , 45 ] .
What has remained unclear is why this construction should be justified for learned world models, what can be recovered without paired counterfactual observations, and whether the principle survives nonlinear representations learned from pixels. Our analysis connects the identification problem of causal inference, the disturbance structure of control, and the representations of modern world models. In particular, factual training of the predictor is sufficient under the stated shared-input conditions, without additional propensity weighting or encoder retraining
( , and ).
blocks.zh:
残余修正在控制理论中是熟悉的,其中扰动观测者,无抵消模型预测控制,以及从观测到的轨迹产生的迭代学习控制再利用错误[39,35,41,2,11].
同样,添加-噪声结构因果模型提供了通往个别反事实的经典途径[44,45].
尚不清楚的是,为什么这种构建应该为有学问的世界模型辩护,没有对等的反事实观测可以回收什么,以及该原理是否延续了从像素学来的非线性表述. 我们的分析将因果推论的识别问题,控制的扰动结构,以及现代世界模型的表述联系起来. 特别是,在所述共同投入条件下,对预测器进行事实培训就足够了,没有增加偏重或编码器再培训
(和.

blocks.en: We test these claims using rendered physical simulators and frozen self-supervised image encoders, DINOv2 [ 40 ] in two sizes and masked autoencoders (MAE) [ 23 ] , and repeat the main comparison with four further frozen encoders, DINOv3 [ 56 ] , SigLIP 2 [ 58 ] , CLIP [ 50 ] and EVA-02 [ 16 ] . We score predicted physical quantities, such as joint angles and positions, by their R 2 R^{2} against the true counterfactual outcome, i.e., the fraction of its variance they explain ( physical counterfactual R 2 R^{2} ). On four environments, with DINOv2 and MAE, counterfactual world models improve physical counterfactual R 2 R^{2} from 38 38 – 46 % 46\% to 86 86 – 96 % 96\% using the same factual predictors, with the correction applied after a readout of these quantities fitted on factual frames; applied to the image features themselves, which needs no state labels, it reaches 73 73 – 94 % 94\% . On the fifth, the BlueROV2 underwater vehicle, they reach 90 90 – 94 % 94\% with sixteen times more factual data. They outperform even an oracle predictor that knows the true simulator and its full state, but not the disturbance that occurred, and therefore predicts the average outcome. With the four further encoders, correction after the readout reaches 81 81 – 95 % 95\% on the first four environments. In hindsight planning, the counterfactual model reaches the goal in 35 35 – 69 % 69\% of events, compared with 14 14 – 23 % 23\% for the true-simulator planner without access to the observed outcome. The experiments also recover the predicted failure modes, including contacts, folded coordinates, and disturbances that multiply the command. These results demonstrate that the observed outcome can be more informative for individual counterfactual reasoning than an otherwise perfect predictive model.
blocks.zh: 我们使用制成的物理模拟器和冷冻的自我监督的图像编码器检验这些索赔,DINov2 [40]分两个尺寸和蒙面自动编码器(MAE [23]),并重复与四个进一步冷冻的编码器的主要比较,DINov3 [56],SigLIP 2 [58],CLIP [50]和EVA-02 [16]。 我们用他们的R 2 R QX2 = = = 真实的反事实结果, 即他们所解释的差异( 物理反事实 R 2 RQX2 } ) 的一小部分来计算预测的物理量。 在四个环境中,与DINOv2和MAE一起,反事实世界模型利用相同的事实预测器改进了物理反事实R 2 R^{2}从38 38 — — 46 % 46 — — 到86 86 — — 96 % 96 — — , 修正是在这些量的读出后应用在事实框架上;适用于图像特征本身,不需要国家标签,它达到了73 — — 94 % 。 在第五架BlueROV2水下飞行器上,它们达到了90 90 — — 94 % 94 — — 拥有16倍于真实数据. 它们甚至比一个知道真实模拟器及其完全状态的神谕预测器还要好,但不会发生扰动,因此可以预测平均结果. 有了另外四个编码器,读出后的校正在前四个环境中达到了81 81 — 95% 95 — 。 在后视规划中,反事实模型在3535 — — 69 % 69 — —的事件中达到了目标,而1414 — 23 % 23 — —的真模拟器规划者没有获得观察到的结果。 实验还恢复了预测的故障模式,包括接触,折叠坐标,以及使指令倍增的扰动. 这些结果表明,所观察到的结果对于个别的反事实推理而言,比起一个原本完美的预测模型,可能更能说明问题。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. • First , we establish the nonidentification of individual counterfactuals from factual world models, including a minimax impossibility result and an explicit gauge ambiguity that persists even with exact factual likelihoods: the latent noise of a generative model can be relabeled separately for each action without changing any factual prediction ( ). • Second , we derive residual reuse from the short-time structure of physical dynamics, prove its exactness under additivity, characterize its interaction error and failure modes, and establish its minimax rate-optimality from unpaired factual data ( and ). • Third , we validate the resulting counterfactual world models from pixels, across seven frozen image encoders, physical disturbances, hindsight-planning tasks, and controlled violations of the assumptions ( ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 • 首先,我们从实际世界模型中确定不识别个别反事实,包括微小不可能的结果,以及即使有确切的事实可能性也仍然存在的明确的模糊度:基因模型的潜在噪声可以就每项行动分别重新贴上标签,而不改变任何事实预测(......)。 第二,我们从物理动力学的短期结构中获取剩余再利用,在相加性下证明它的准确性,确定其相互作用的误差和失败模式的特点,并从未经证实的事实数据中确定其微小比例的优化(和)。 第三,我们从像素中验证由此产生的反事实世界模型,通过7个冷冻图像编码器、物理扰动、后视规划任务以及控制下违反假设的情况(.)。

blocks.en: First , we establish the nonidentification of individual counterfactuals from factual world models, including a minimax impossibility result and an explicit gauge ambiguity that persists even with exact factual likelihoods: the latent noise of a generative model can be relabeled separately for each action without changing any factual prediction ( ).
blocks.zh: 首先,我们确定没有从事实世界模型中识别个别的反事实,包括一个最小不可能的结果,以及即使有确切的事实可能性,仍然持续存在的明确的度量模糊性:基因模型的潜在噪声可以在不改变任何事实预测的情况下,就每项行动分别重新贴上标签(......)。

blocks.en: Second , we derive residual reuse from the short-time structure of physical dynamics, prove its exactness under additivity, characterize its interaction error and failure modes, and establish its minimax rate-optimality from unpaired factual data ( and ).
blocks.zh: 第二,我们从物理动力学的短期结构中获得剩余再利用,在相加性下证明它的准确性,描述其相互作用的误差和故障模式,并从未经证实的事实数据(和)中确定它的最小比率-优化性。

blocks.en: Third , we validate the resulting counterfactual world models from pixels, across seven frozen image encoders, physical disturbances, hindsight-planning tasks, and controlled violations of the assumptions ( ).
blocks.zh: 第三,我们从像素中验证由此产生的反事实世界模型,通过7个冷冻图像编码器、物理扰动、后视规划任务以及控制下违反假设的情况(.)。

blocks.en: 2  World Models Need Individual Counterfactuals
blocks.zh: 2 世界模式 需要个人反事实

blocks.en: World models and causal models describe the same underlying object from different perspectives: how a system responds to actions in the presence of unobserved disturbances. We first distinguish the quantities learned by ordinary world models from the individual counterfactuals needed after observing an outcome ( ). We then show why individual counterfactuals cannot be identified from factual transitions alone, even by a perfect generative model ( ). Finally, we identify the additional structure under which counterfactual reasoning becomes possible ( ).
blocks.zh: 世界模型和因果模型从不同的角度描述同一个基本对象:一个系统如何在出现无观察扰动时对行动作出反应. 我们首先将普通世界模型所学到的数量与观测结果后所需的个别反事实区分开来(.). 然后,我们说明为什么不能仅从事实过渡中确定个别的反事实,甚至不能用完美的基因模型(......)。 最后,我们确定了可以进行反事实推理的附加结构(......)。

blocks.en: 2.1  World Models Estimate Average Effects, Surprises Ask for Individual Ones
blocks.zh: 2.1 世界模型估计平均影响,惊喜要求个人

blocks.en: Let s t s_{t} denote the physical state of a system, a t a_{t} the action applied at time t t , and ε t \varepsilon_{t} an unobserved disturbance. The transition obeys s t + 1 = F s ​ ( s t , a t , ε t ) . s_{t+1}=F_{s}(s_{t},a_{t},\varepsilon_{t}). (2) This single equation admits three interpretations. In control theory, F s F_{s} describes a disturbed dynamical system, or plant . In causal inference, it is a structural causal equation: the action is an intervention, and ε t \varepsilon_{t} is the exogenous variable held fixed when constructing a counterfactual [ 44 ] . In world modeling, it is the unknown physical mechanism that a learned predictor attempts to approximate. Connections between dynamical systems and structural causal models have been formalized through differential equations [ 34 , 51 , 46 ] .

blocks.en: Even when the conditional interventional means are identified exactly, they do not determine the individual effect. The CATE averages over disturbances compatible with Z = z Z=z , while the ITE compares two outcomes under the same realized disturbance. Equivalently, the ATE and CATE depend on marginal distributions of potential outcomes, whereas the ITE depends on how those outcomes are coupled across actions, i.e., on their joint distribution, which says which outcome under a ′ a^{\prime} belongs to the same event as a given outcome under a a . This missing coupling is the fundamental obstacle to individual counterfactual world modeling.

blocks.en: We say that the action and the disturbance interact when the effect of changing the action depends on which disturbance occurred. Without interaction, the ITE is the same in every event and therefore equals the CATE; with interaction, the two differ by an amount set by the unobserved disturbance. For the boat of , a uniform current would drift the boat by the same amount whatever its heading, so turning would move the boat’s position by the same amount in every event, and its counterfactual position would be the observed one plus the CATE. Its current varies slowly in space, so the drift depends only slightly on where the boat goes, and the interaction is small; measures how it grows as the eddies shrink. A worn actuator that delivers only a fraction of the command is the opposite case: how far a larger command moves the system depends on the wear, so no single correction is right for every event. Interaction is what separates the coupling from a plain shift: without it, the coupling reduces to a shift by the CATE, which factual data identify, and the interaction measures how far the true coupling departs from that shift. Factual data alone cannot tell the two cases apart: the two mechanisms of the next subsection ( ) share their factual laws, yet the first has no interaction and the second does. shows when physics keeps the interaction small.

blocks.en: 2.2  No Factual World Model Identifies Individual Counterfactuals

blocks.en: Can a sufficiently accurate or expressive world model recover the missing coupling and estimate individual treatment effects? In general, it cannot. Unpaired factual data reveal the outcome distribution associated with each action, but do not record outcomes under two actions for the same realized disturbance. We first establish that this ambiguity persists with infinite data, even under perfect generative world modeling.
blocks.zh: 一个足够准确或表现性的世界模型能否恢复缺失的耦合并估计个别治疗效果? 一般来说,它不能。 未经证实的事实数据揭示了与每项行动有关的结果分布,但没有将结果记录在针对同一已实现扰动的两个行动中。 我们首先确认,这种模糊性继续存在于无穷无尽的数据之中,甚至在完美的基因世界模型化下也是如此。

It does not, however, reveal their joint law. Different joint distributions can share exactly the same marginals while assigning different outcomes to the same individual under alternative actions. blocks.en: The ambiguity is not due to limited data, imperfect optimization, or insufficient model capacity. Even when all interventional laws are known exactly, the minimax risk for estimating an individual counterfactual remains bounded away from zero, as does that of the individual treatment effect ( and ). The two mechanisms can also be smooth; smoothness of the factual outcome laws alone does not identify their coupling. This is an instance of the causal hierarchy separating interventions from counterfactuals [ 8 ] , and of the classical nonidentification of the joint distribution of potential outcomes from experimental marginals [ 24 ] . A deterministic world model predicting the conditional mean therefore cannot recover the individual counterfactual merely by becoming more accurate. But perhaps a generative world model could do better, by sampling a latent disturbance and reusing it under another action. The next result shows why factual training does not identify this operation either.

blocks.en:
The theorem identifies the precise missing information: factual training constrains the distribution of latent noise at each action, but not how a particular realization of that noise corresponds across actions. This is an action-dependent gauge freedom , a term borrowed from physics for a change of description, here a relabeling of the noise, that leaves every observable prediction unchanged. The freedom is real whenever ν 
u admits a ν 
u -preserving bijection other than the identity, as any continuous noise law does, e.g., through a reflection of a centered Gaussian; only deterministic dynamics, with ν 
u a point mass, leave nothing to relabel. A normalizing flow with an exact likelihood can infer a latent variable from an observed transition, yet factual data alone do not establish that this latent variable represents the same physical disturbance under a different action. Related nonidentification results for bijective causal models appear in Nasr-Esfahany et al. [37] , Nasr-Esfahany and Kiciman [36] ; see also neural causal models in Xia et al. [62] . The same limitation applies beyond invertible generators. A diffusion or latent-variable world model may sample realistic outcomes under alternative actions, but its factual objective does not, by itself, determine which alternative outcome corresponds to the particular event that was observed. Individual counterfactuals therefore require information about the correspondence across actions that factual predictive accuracy does not measure.

blocks.en: 2.3  Every Counterfactual Needs Structure Beyond Factual Data
blocks.zh: 2.3 事实数据以外的每个反事实需求结构

blocks.en: The preceding results establish a boundary between learning factual distributions and identifying individual counterfactuals. Factual data can identify interventional quantities under the appropriate assumptions, but the coupling between potential outcomes requires additional structure. This structure may come from paired observations, a known mechanism, restrictions on the disturbance, or assumptions on how actions affect the system.
blocks.zh: 上述结果确定了学习事实分布与识别个别反事实之间的界限。 事实数据可以根据适当的假设确定干预量,但潜在结果之间的结合需要额外的结构。 这种结构可能来自对偶观测,一种已知的机制,对扰动的限制,或对行动如何影响系统的假设.

blocks.en: Table 1: What factual world models identify, and what individual counterfactuals require. Under suitable exchangeability and coverage assumptions, factual transitions identify interventional quantities, but not the correspondence between outcomes under different actions. Individual counterfactuals become identifiable through additional assumptions or paired observations. For smooth physical dynamics, residual reuse instead provides an approximation with a controlled error and explicit failure modes.

blocks.en:
Different approaches to counterfactual reasoning provide the missing coupling in different ways. Structural causal models impose restrictions on how exogenous variables generate outcomes [ 44 , 45 ] . Additive-noise models provide an especially simple case: the observed residual identifies the disturbance contribution, which can then be reused under a different action [ 26 ] . Monotone scalar responses identify counterfactuals through rank preservation: if a scalar outcome increases with a scalar disturbance under every action, an event keeps its quantile in the outcome distribution across actions, so the counterfactual is the outcome at the same quantile under a ′ a^{\prime} (rank transport). Suitable bijective mechanisms can support more general transport constructions [ 14 , 5 , 37 , 61 ] .
Alternatively, paired observations or a known simulator can provide the correspondence between actions directly [ 6 , 27 , 12 , 38 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
反事实推理的不同方法以不同的方式提供了缺失的耦合. 结构因果模型对外部变量如何产生结果施加了限制[44,45]. 添加噪声模型提供了一个特别简单的例子:观察到的残留物识别出扰动促进因素,然后可以在不同的动作下重新使用[26]. Monoone scalar反应通过分级保全识别出反事实:如果分级结果在每次动作下随分级扰动而增加,则一个事件在结果的跨动作分布中保持其四分法,所以反事实就是在'a^{\prime}(分级运输)下在同一个四分法下的结果. 适当的双射机制可以支持更一般的交通建设[14,5,37,61].
或者,配对的观察或已知的模拟器可以直接提供行动[6、27、12、38、43]之间的对应。

blocks.en:
Counterfactual reasoning has also been studied in reinforcement learning and world modeling, including data augmentation [ 30 , 47 , 48 ] ,
credit assignment [ 33 ] ,
explanation [ 60 ] ,
and counterfactual action-sequence optimization [ 59 , 22 ] .
Observed trajectory residuals have been reused to correct model errors in model-based control [ 1 ] .
More recent approaches study counterfactual prediction in driving world models through abduction, action, and prediction [ 63 ] ,
noise-coupled branching in interactive video world models [ 31 ] ,
and action-discriminative latent models for counterfactual model predictive control [ 49 ] .
These works differ in their assumptions, supervision, and target counterfactual queries, but share (i) the need for some correspondence between alternative outcomes, (ii) expert knowledge in some structural model, or (iii) access to simulators for paired data generation.

blocks.en: Exchangeability and overlap hold whenever the logged actions depend only on what the world model sees, plus independent exploration that covers the queried actions ( ); an operator who perceives more than is recorded can break them. The coupling requirements of are harder to meet. Paired outcomes and known mechanisms are rarely available outside simulation, and factual data can never confirm additivity or rank preservation, since the coupling they assert is not identified ( ). We therefore do not postulate additivity itself: derives it, up to second order, from one physical assumption, separate action and disturbance channels, with an explicit error bound, and tests where it breaks.

blocks.en: Physical dynamics can constrain the correspondence between outcomes under different actions without learning it or using a known simulator. When actions and disturbances enter through separate force-like channels, the effect of changing an action is approximately independent of the realized disturbance over a sufficiently short transition. The approximation error is governed by their interaction, rather than by the magnitude of the disturbance itself. This distinction matters for learned world models. Instead of attempting to infer the true exogenous variable or identify a generative coupling from factual data, we can reuse the discrepancy between the observed outcome and the factual prediction. The world model then provides only the change attributable to the alternative action. The resulting counterfactual depends on an observable residual and two ordinary predictions, not on a learned correspondence between latent noise variables.
blocks.zh: 物理动力学可以限制不同动作下的结果之间的对应性,而不学习它或使用已知的模拟器. 当行动和骚乱通过单独的类似武力的渠道进入时,改变某一行动的影响大致独立于由于过渡时间足够短而实际发生的骚乱。 近似误差受它们的相互作用支配,而不是受扰动本身的大小支配. 这种区别对学习过的世界模式很重要。 我们不是试图从事实数据中推断出真正的外部变量或确定基因结合,而是可以重新利用观察到的结果与事实预测之间的差异。 然后,世界模式只提供可归因于替代行动的变化。 由此产生的反事实取决于可观察到的残余和两个普通的预测,而不是潜在噪声变量之间学到的对应.

blocks.en: The next section formalizes this principle. We first establish why residual reuse is exact in additive systems, then quantify the error introduced by action–disturbance interactions. Finally, we show that the short-time structure of physical dynamics controls this interaction and that the resulting approximation achieves the minimax-optimal rate from unpaired factual data ( ).
blocks.zh: 下一节正式确定了这一原则。 我们首先确定残留再利用在添加剂系统中的确切原因,然后量化动作-扰动相互作用引起的错误。 最后,我们表明,物理动力学的短期结构控制了这种相互作用,由此产生的近似值从未经证实的事实数据中实现了最小最大最佳速率(......)。

blocks.en: 3  Natura Non Facit Saltus: Counterfactuals from a World Without Leaps
blocks.zh: 3 Natura 非外形盐:来自一个无漏世界的反事实

blocks.en: The previous section established that factual transition laws do not identify individual counterfactuals ( ). Identification requires additional structure on how the same disturbance affects outcomes under different actions. Here we consider physical dynamics in which actions and disturbances enter through separate force-like channels. Their effects add in the instantaneous dynamics, while their interaction accumulates over time. We first derive residual reuse and characterize its exactness under additive responses. We then express its error in terms of the action–disturbance interaction. For smooth physical systems, this interaction is second-order in the transition duration, yielding a minimax-optimal counterfactual approximation. Finally, we establish the conditions under which a factual world model trained by squared loss provides the required action contrast.

blocks.en: Residual reuse is exact under additivity, and the interaction bound quantifies its error beyond that regime. In physical systems, the principle behind our title, natura non facit saltus (nature makes no leaps), takes a concrete form: separate action and disturbance forces accumulate over time and interact only through subsequent changes of state. This yields approximate additivity over a short transition, with a counterfactual error rate that we prove is minimax optimal given unpaired factual data and one observed outcome. In Newtonian and Lagrangian mechanics, this separate-force structure takes the form M ⁡ ( q ) ​ q ¨ = τ a ​ ( q , a ) + τ ε ​ ( q , q ˙ , ε ) − c ⁡ ( q , q ˙ ) . M(q)\ddot{q}=\tau_{a}(q,a)+\tau_{\varepsilon}(q,\dot{q},\varepsilon)-c(q,\dot{q}). (17) Here q q denotes configuration, M ⁡ ( q ) M(q) the mass matrix, τ a \tau_{a} and τ ε \tau_{\varepsilon} the action and disturbance forces, and c c the remaining mechanical terms; dots denote time derivatives, so q ˙ \dot{q} is the velocity and q ¨ \ddot{q} the acceleration. At a fixed position and velocity, the two force contributions add; their interaction arises as the action changes the state at which the disturbance acts, and conversely. This separate-channel structure is assumed, not derived from smoothness: the worn actuator of is smooth yet interacts with the action at first order, and we list it among the violations at the end of this subsection.

blocks.en: The numerator is O ⁡ ( h 4 ) O(h^{4}) by , while the disturbance-induced variance in the denominator is of order h 2 h^{2} under the separation condition. Hence the relative risk decreases as h 2 h^{2} . This is the relevant guarantee: residual reuse removes an increasing fraction of the disturbance uncertainty as the transition duration decreases. The corollary says how fast the error vanishes, not how short is short enough. Its bound holds only below the duration stated in the corollary, and guarantees an improvement over ignoring the outcome only at shorter durations still; both limits shrink when the remainder constant C C grows or when the disturbance moves the outcome less (smaller κ ​ σ \kappa\sigma ), and these constants depend on the system. Whether the transitions of a given system are short enough is therefore an empirical question. Factual data cannot settle it, since the interaction is not identified ( ); measures it on our simulators.

blocks.en: The first-order argument also extends to certain partially observed inertial systems. With pose-only observations, an unknown initial velocity contributes to the transition, while applied forces affect position at order h 2 h^{2} . The interaction between the force contribution and the disturbance appears at higher order. Under the conditions of , the mean-squared error of residual reuse is O ⁡ ( h 6 ) O(h^{6}) despite the hidden velocity. If, in addition, distinct disturbances move the pose apart at order h 2 h^{2} , as in the separation condition of , the variance they induce is at least of order h 4 h^{4} , and the relative rate is again O ⁡ ( h 2 ) O(h^{2}) . This is a specific property of inertial dynamics, rather than a general guarantee for arbitrary insufficient representations.

blocks.en: The short-time bound gives a rate achievable by residual reuse. We next ask whether another estimator could achieve a uniformly smaller risk using the same information. The estimator may know the exact factual transition laws at every action and duration and may condition on the observed factual outcome. It does not observe paired outcomes under different actions for the same disturbance.

blocks.en: The lower-bound construction uses two worlds with identical factual transition laws but different same-disturbance couplings. It follows that additional model capacity or a more accurate factual likelihood cannot uniformly improve the rate without additional assumptions or information.

blocks.en: The preceding guarantees use the population conditional mean μ h \mu_{h} , whereas a counterfactual world model uses the action contrast supplied by a learned predictor. We show that μ h \mu_{h} can be learned by ordinary squared-loss training on a frozen pretrained encoder, regardless of its pretraining objective, and that an available factual predictor can be reused when it already supplies the required contrast. We also state when the predicted action contrast equals the conditional average effect of changing the action; by ( 16 ), only the error in this contrast contributes additional counterfactual risk.

blocks.en: The conditional-expectation decomposition applies to any fixed encoder: pretraining determines the features being predicted, while squared-loss training identifies their conditional mean on the factual support. blocks.en: Frozen JEPA encoders, masked autoencoders, contrastively trained representations and supervised checkpoints can thus supply the features for a factual world model. Our experiments fit a new squared-loss predictor on these frozen features; when a pretrained world model already provides the required action contrast for the chosen context and target representation, both its encoder and predictor can instead be reused without retraining. An arbitrary pretrained predictor is not guaranteed to estimate this contrast accurately: its contrast error enters ( 16 ), and counterfactual validity still requires supported actions, the identification conditions below and the preceding structural assumptions.

blocks.en: A controller choosing actions from the observation history supplied to the world model satisfies this condition when its additional randomization is independent of the potential outcomes, even if the physical disturbance is unobserved. If a teleoperator instead adjusts the command using wind information unavailable to the model, the logged action carries additional information about the disturbance and can confound the command effect with the wind effect. Action coverage remains a separate requirement: a deterministic controller may satisfy the shared-input condition while choosing only one action at each context, leaving alternative action contrasts unsupported.
blocks.zh: 控制器从提供给世界模型的观测历史中选择动作满足了这个条件,如果其额外的随机化独立于潜在结果,即使物理扰动是不可见的. 如果一个电信操作员反而利用模型中无法获得的风信息来调整指令,记录的动作会携带关于扰动的额外信息,并且可以将指令效应与风效应混淆. 行动覆盖范围仍然是一项单独要求:确定控制器可能满足共享输入条件,而在每个上下文中只选择一项行动,而替代行动则得不到支持。

blocks.en: Under exchangeability and overlap, ordinary squared-loss regression identifies the conditional interventional mean without inverse-propensity weighting: by ( ), positive input weights leave the unrestricted population minimizer unchanged. This invariance concerns the target, while weighting can affect finite-sample accuracy and the approximation selected by a misspecified predictor class [ 55 ] . Propensity-based and doubly robust methods remain useful for other causal targets, including marginal functionals involving nuisance estimation [ 15 ] , but do not by themselves identify the same-event coupling missing from factual data ( ).
blocks.zh: 在可交换性和重叠性下,普通的平方亏损回归确定有条件的干预平均值,而不采用反比加权法:通过( ),正输入加权法使不受限制的人口最小化值保持不变。 这种偏差与目标有关,而加权会影响有限-样本的准确性,以及被误用的预测器类选择的近似值[55]. 基于公理的双倍强力方法对于其他因果目标仍然有用,包括涉及扰动估计的边缘功能[15],但本身并不能确定事实数据中缺失的同一事件结合(.)。

blocks.en: For counterfactual prediction, the fitted world model only needs to estimate μ ⁡ ( H t , a ′ ) − μ ⁡ ( H t , a ) \mu(H_{t},a^{\prime})-\mu(H_{t},a) accurately, since errors shared across actions cancel in ( 16 ); an action-dependent bias, however, enters the correction directly. Thus, a frozen pretrained encoder and an ordinary factual predictor supply the learned part of our construction whenever their supported action contrast has the required interventional interpretation. The observed outcome supplies the realized residual, and the physical dynamics control how accurately it transfers between actions in the chosen coordinates. We test these requirements below and, separately, test on three large external corpora whether predictors fitted on frozen DINOv2-S and V-JEPA 2 features leave any input-predictable residual ( ).

blocks.en: collects the assumptions of residual reuse, where each is stated formally, and a real system where it holds or fails. The first two make the predicted action contrast causal, the next three keep the action–disturbance interaction small, and the last two concern the coordinates in which the residual is reused. In our benchmarks, the factual action of the evaluated transition is drawn uniformly from the command support, independently of the disturbance, so the first two hold by design; tests the other five.
blocks.zh: 收集残余再利用的假设,在每种情况下都正式说明,在每种情况下都收集实际的系统。 前两款使预测的动作对比因果,后三款使动作-扰动相互作用保持小,后两款则涉及剩余物重用时的坐标. 在我们的基准中,经过评估的过渡的事实行动是统一地从指挥支持中抽取的,独立于扰动,所以前两个是按设计进行的;测试其他五个.

blocks.en: 4  Counterfactual World Models: Empirical Validation
blocks.zh: 4 反事实世界模型:经验验证

blocks.en: We first test the physical approximation using simulator outcomes, then evaluate counterfactual prediction from pixels with frozen encoders and predictors trained on factual transitions. We examine how the disturbance mechanism and output coordinates affect residual reuse, and conclude with hindsight planning and the effect of disturbance persistence. No counterfactual outcome is used for training or model selection.
blocks.zh: 我们首先用模拟结果来测试物理近似,然后评价来自像素的反事实预测,用冷冻编码器和预测器对事实过渡进行培训. 我们研究扰动机制和输出坐标如何影响残留的再利用,并以事后规划和扰动持久性的影响作为结论。 培训或模型选择没有采用反事实结果。

4.2  Counterfactual Prediction from Pixels
blocks.zh: 4.2 对像素的反事实预测

blocks.en: We use seven native simulators rendered at 224 × 224 224\times 224 : HandReach, Ball-in-Cup, FetchReach, liquid transport (PassWater), Racetrack, Push-T and BlueROV2 ( ). Each transition receives a bounded disturbance with a physical meaning, such as an offset in a servo target, force, position goal or thrust. After two transitions of a task-directed behavior policy, we sample a factual action and three distinct alternative actions uniformly from the declared command support. Evaluation branches share the same source state and realized disturbance. We calibrate the environments so that both actions and disturbances affect the outcome and verify image-based recovery of the scored quantities; the complete design and observability protocol is in and . The primary comparisons use HandReach, Ball-in-Cup, FetchReach, PassWater and BlueROV2; Racetrack and Push-T are retained as diagnostics.

blocks.en: Images are encoded by frozen, publicly released self-supervised vision transformers, without fine-tuning: DINOv2 [ 40 ] , trained by self-distillation, in its small and base sizes (DINOv2-S, DINOv2-B), and the masked autoencoder MAE [ 23 ] , trained to reconstruct masked image patches, in its base size (MAE-B). These two cover the two main families of self-supervised pretraining, joint embedding and reconstruction, and DINOv2 is the encoder of recent JEPA world models [ 64 ] . Each frame is represented by the encoder’s class-token (CLS) embedding. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3-B [ 56 ] , SigLIP 2-B [ 58 ] , CLIP-B [ 50 ] and EVA-02-B [ 16 ] , go through the same pipeline, each with the default pooling of its released checkpoint ( and ). blocks.en: With one frame and 8 8 k factual episodes per environment, correction after the readout reaches 85.6 85.6 – 95.7 % 95.7\% R 2 R^{2} on HandReach, Ball-in-Cup, FetchReach and PassWater, compared with 38.1 38.1 – 45.6 % 45.6\% for the same trained predictors and 49.1 49.1 – 51.1 % 51.1\% for the oracle predictors without the outcome ( ). Thus, the improvement uses the realized disturbance information in the factual outcome; it cannot be explained by copying that outcome or improving the underlying predictor. The four further encoders give the same picture: on the same four environments, wherever they pass our disturbance-recovery criterion, correction after the readout reaches 81.0 81.0 – 95.3 % 95.3\% , against 34.7 34.7 – 45.4 % 45.4\% for their trained predictors, and DINOv3-B gives the highest values of all seven encoders on HandReach and Ball-in-Cup, 88.8 88.8 and 95.0 % 95.0\% ( ).

The interaction ratios of and are computed from simulator outcomes in physical coordinates, so they are the same for every encoder. An encoder changes the counterfactual error only through the error of the learned action contrast, the second term of ( 16 ), and through the readout: across the seven encoders, correction after the readout ranges over 81.0 81.0 – 88.8 % 88.8\% on HandReach, against 98.3 % 98.3\% with exact simulator means.

blocks.en: The two constructions of need different supervision. Correction in feature space, ( ), uses only the frozen encoder and the factual predictor, so it applies to any pretrained representation. Correction after the readout, ( ), also needs the readout, fitted on physical-state labels of factual frames. We score both through the same readout, which any evaluation in physical units requires. Without labels, correction in feature space reaches 73.4 73.4 – 94.1 % 94.1\% on HandReach, Ball-in-Cup, FetchReach and PassWater, against 38.1 38.1 – 45.6 % 45.6\% for the trained predictors, so most of the gain needs no state supervision. The readout adds 1.4 1.4 – 4.3 4.3 points on the first three and 12.1 12.1 – 17.7 17.7 points on PassWater. On BlueROV2, the readout is needed: correction in feature space stays near the oracle predictor without the outcome at the standard data size, and reaches 65.9 65.9 – 72.2 % 72.2\% with sixteen times the data, against 90.1 90.1 – 93.5 % 93.5\% after the readout ( ). traces this gap to the coordinates: the full feature vector is not additive, and the readout selects coordinates in which the action and the disturbance nearly add.
blocks.zh: 两种建筑需要不同的监管. 特征空间的校正( ) , 仅使用冷冻编码器和事实预测器, 因此它适用于任何预先训练的表示. 在读出后进行更正,( ) 还需要读出, 安装在事实框架的物理状态标签上。 我们通过同样的读数得分,任何物理单位的评价都需要。 没有标签,特色空间的校正达到73.4 73.4 — — 94.1% 在HandReach、Ball-in-Cup、FettleReach和PassWater上的94.1 % , 而训练有素的预测器则达到38.1 38.1 % — 45.6 % , 所以大部分收益不需要国家监管。 读出后在前3位增加了1.41.4 – 4.3 4.3分,在PassWater上增加了12.1 – 17.7 17.7分. 在 BlueROV2 上,读取需要: 特征空间的校正停留在 oracle 预测器附近,但没有标准数据大小的结果, 并且达到65.9 65.9 — — 72.2% 72.2 — — 占数据16倍, 而读取器( ) 后为90.1 90.1 — — 93.5% 93.5 — — — — 位于坐标上: 完全的特征向量不是添加剂,读取器选择了动作和扰动几乎增加的坐标。

blocks.en: Equation ( 16 ) separates the interaction error from the error in the predicted action contrast. Selecting the predictor configuration by factual validation loss reduces factual error by 8 8 – 17 % 17\% in every tested cell and improves or preserves counterfactual accuracy in five of six environments ( ). Push-T provides an exception: factual feature error improves while the predicted pusher action contrast becomes less accurate. Factual loss over the full feature vector therefore provides an imperfect measure of the action contrast required by residual reuse.
blocks.zh: 等式 (16 ) 将预测动作对比中的相互作用错误与错误区分开来. 通过事实验证损失选择预测器配置,将每个被测试的单元格中的事实错误减少8 8 — — 17% 17 — — — ,并在6个环境的5个中提高或保持反事实准确性( )。 Push-T提供了一个例外:事实特征错误有所改善,而预测的推力动作对比则变得不太准确. 因此,整个特性矢量上的事实损失为剩余再利用所需的动作对比提供了不完善的尺度。

blocks.en: Increasing the factual data improves counterfactual prediction without changing the correction. With MAE-B, an eightfold increase raises readout-corrected R 2 R^{2} from 69.8 69.8 to 85.6 % 85.6\% on HandReach, 80.8 80.8 to 94.2 % 94.2\% on Ball-in-Cup, 90.7 90.7 to 95.7 % 95.7\% on FetchReach and 83.9 83.9 to 94.8 % 94.8\% on PassWater ( ). BlueROV2 reaches 85.7 85.7 – 88.2 % 88.2\% across encoders with four times the standard data and 90.1 90.1 – 93.5 % 93.5\% with sixteen times the data; its oracle predictor without the outcome remains at 51.8 % 51.8\% . These results identify factual prediction error as a practical limitation even when the physical interaction is small.
blocks.zh: 增加事实数据可以改进反事实预测,而不改变更正。 与MAE-B相比,读取校正的R 2 R^{2}增加8倍,HandReach从69.8 69.8升至85.6%,Ball-in-Cup从80.8 80.8升至94.2%,FettleReach从90.7 90.7升至95.7%,PassWater从83.9 83.9升至94.8%。 BlueROV2在编码器中达到85.785.7 — 88.2% 88.2% 88.2% 横跨编码器,其标准数据为4倍,90.1 90.1 — 93.5% 93.5% 的数据为16倍;其无结果的甲骨文预测器仍为51.8% 51.8 % 。 这些结果将事实预测错误确定为一个实际限制,即使物理相互作用很小。

blocks.en: In this ablation, each disturbance has two components ( ): a fresh one, independent and identically distributed (IID) over transitions, and a persistent one, correlated across transitions. Past frames can reveal the persistent component, whereas only the current outcome carries information about the fresh one. The main benchmark is fully fresh. On HandReach, increasing the fresh share of disturbance variance from 25 25 to 100 % 100\% reduces the trained predictor’s R 2 R^{2} from 71.7 71.7 to 38.1 % 38.1\% , whereas the counterfactual model goes only from 91.4 91.4 to 85.6 % 85.6\% ( ). With half the variance persistent, increasing the context from one to three frames changes trained-predictor accuracy by − 2.3 -2.3 to + 2.1 +2.1 points and counterfactual accuracy by − 4.5 -4.5 to + 1.6 +1.6 points. The population benefit of additional history is therefore not consistently realized by these finite fitted models. The formal risk comparison and complete history results are given in and .
blocks.zh: 在这种分裂中,每个扰动有两个组成部分(......):一个新的组成部分,独立和相同地分布在过渡上;一个持久的组成部分,在过渡上相互关联。 过去的框架可以揭示持久性部分,而只有目前的结果才包含关于新鲜部分的信息。 主要基准全新. 在HandReach上,将扰动差异的新比例从25 25 % 增加到100 % 100 — — 将训练有素的预测器R 2 R — — 2 R — — 从71.7降至38.1 % 38.1 — — — 而反事实模型从91.4 91.4 升至85.6 — — ( ) 。 一半的扰动长期存在,使上下文从训练有素的导师精度从2.3-2.3升至+2.1+2.1,反事实精度从4.5-4.5升至+1.6+1.6点。 因此,这些有限装配的模型无法始终如一地实现新增历史的人口惠益。 正式的风险比较和完整历史结果载于和。

blocks.en: 4.3  Conditions and Limits of Residual Reuse
blocks.zh: 4.3 残余物再利用的条件和限度

blocks.en: The interaction analysis predicts how residual reuse changes with the measured coordinates and the disturbance mechanism. We test both using the same factual-training procedure, with a separate factual predictor fitted for each disturbance condition.
blocks.zh: 相互作用分析预测残余再利用如何随着测量坐标和扰动机制而改变。 我们使用同样的事实训练程序,对每个扰动情况分别进行事实预测。

blocks.en: The HandReach predictor also produces accurate fingertip counterfactuals through a second readout fitted on factual frames. On the seven prespecified fingertip coordinates, MAE-B reaches 83.6 % 83.6\% R 2 R^{2} with correction in feature space, against 39.8 % 39.8\% for the trained predictor, − 1.3 % -1.3\% for factual copying and 53.0 % 53.0\% for the oracle predictor without the outcome. The simulator reference with exact means reaches 96.5 % 96.5\% ( ). These nonlinear coordinates therefore retain much of the benefit found on the directly actuated wrist.
blocks.zh: 手提式预测器通过安装在事实框架上的第二次读出,还产生准确的指尖反事实。 在7个预先指定的指尖坐标上,MAE-B达到了83.6%的83.6\%R 2R^{2}在特征空间中进行了校正,而训练有素的预测器为39.8%的39.8\%,事实复制为1.3-1.3\%,甲骨文预测器为53.0%的53.0\%,没有结果。 精确手段的模拟参考值达到96.5% 96.5% 。 因此,这些非线性坐标保留了直接触动腕部的大部分好处。

blocks.en: Residual reuse also works when the disturbance acts on the plant rather than through the command. An external load applied at the HandReach palm reaches the wrist through the configuration-dependent force Jacobian. Its measured interaction is small, ρ ≤ 0.001 \rho\leq 0.001 , and the learned counterfactual reaches 88.7 % 88.7\% with MAE-B and 86.9 % 86.9\% with DINOv2-S after the readout, against 39 39 – 40 % 40\% for the trained predictors and 50 % 50\% for the oracle predictor without the outcome ( ). The disturbance’s point of entry therefore does not determine whether correction succeeds; its interaction with the action does.
blocks.zh: 当扰动对植物产生作用时,残余再利用也起作用,而不是通过命令。 手掌上应用的外部负载通过配置依赖力雅各比安到达手腕. 其测量到的相互作用很小, ^ 0.001\rho\leq 0.001, 学习到的反事实与MAE-B相比达到88.7%的88.7%, 读完后与DINOv2-S相比达到86.9%的86.9%, 而训练有素的预测器则达到39 39 — 40%的40 %, 预言器达到50%的50 % 。 因此,扰动的切入点不能决定校正是否成功;它与动作的相互作用确实如此。

blocks.en: The same physics can give different interaction errors in different coordinates. For BlueROV2, sin ⁡ ( pitch ) \sin(\mathrm{pitch}) is additive with ρ = 0 \rho=0 , whereas the folded coordinate cos ⁡ ( pitch ) \cos(\mathrm{pitch}) gives ρ = 1.67 \rho=1.67 . For the actuator-offset conditions, applying correction after the physical readout improves on decoding the corrected embedding in every environment, by 1.4 1.4 to 25.9 25.9 points ( , including diagnostic Push-T). The readout thus supplies both physical quantities and coordinates with smaller action–disturbance interactions; accurate physical counterfactuals do not establish additivity of the full feature vector ( gives an explicit example).
blocks.zh: 同样的物理学可以在不同的坐标中给出不同的相互作用错误. 对于BlueROV2, sin QQ (pot)\sin(\mathrm{pitch})是添加剂,其添加剂为 $ = 0\rho=0,而折叠的坐标为 $ =\cos(pot)\cos(\mathrm{pitch})给出 $ 1.67\rho=1.67. 对于触发器-抵消条件,在物理读出后应用校正改进了在每个环境中校正嵌入的解码,比1.41.4至25.9 25.9分(包括诊断Push-T). 因此,读出既能提供物理量,又能以较小的动作-扰动相互作用提供坐标;准确的物理反事实不能确定全部特性矢量的相加性(给出一个明确的例子)。

blocks.en: A uniform current makes residual reuse exact on the title-page boat, so one may ask how constant the disturbance must be. We vary the eddies of its current along two axes, with their speed and the mean flow fixed: their size, through the shortest wavelength L L from 1000 1000 boat lengths down to 1.25 1.25 , and how fast their pattern drifts in time, from 0 0 to 3 3 radians per transition. Each condition has its own 128 128 k factual episodes, frozen MAE-B readout and factual predictor ( ). In space, the interaction ratio grows as 1 / L 2 1/L^{2} , from 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} at L = 1000 L=1000 to 0.08 0.08 at L = 5 L=5 : the gradient of the current scales as 1 / L 1/L , and it sets how differently the current pushes the boat at the endpoints of two headings, one boat length apart. The growth slows once the waves approach the length of the move, and ρ \rho reaches 0.49 0.49 at L = 1.25 L=1.25 . The counterfactual world model follows ρ \rho with a nearly constant estimation error: its relative risk lies 0.12 0.12 to 0.15 0.15 above ρ \rho at every size, from 0.13 0.13 to 0.64 0.64 , while the trained predictor stays at 1.11 1.11 – 1.17 1.17 , slightly above the oracle predictor without the outcome ( ). In time, ρ \rho stays at 0.020 0.020 – 0.022 0.022 and the counterfactual relative risk at 0.15 0.15 – 0.17 0.17 for every phase rate: all headings of an event meet the field at the same instants, so the correction depends on how the current differs between the places the actions lead to, not on how it changes over time. A change over time would matter only if a residual observed in one transition were reused in a later one. Residual reuse therefore needs a disturbance that varies little over the distance separating the outcomes of alternative actions. These collections are diagnostic, since the oracle predictor already reaches 86 86 – 97 % 97\% position R 2 R^{2} and recovery of the north-south drift falls just below 95 % 95\% ( ).
blocks.zh: 统一的电流使标题页船上的剩余再利用精确,因此人们可能会问扰动必须有多恒定. 我们沿着两根轴来改变它的电流,它们的速度和平均流量是固定的:它们的大小,通过最短的波长LL,从1000个船长降到1.25个1.25个,以及它们的图案在时间上漂移的速度,从0到3个弧度,每次过渡从0. 每个条件都有自己的128,128千个事实事件,冻结的MAE-B读出和事实预测器(.). 在空间中,交互比增长为1/L 2 1/L^{2},从2×10−6 2\times 10×6}在L=1000 L=1000 到0.08 0.08 在L=5 L=5:当前天平的梯度为1/L 1/L,它设定了水流在两个标题的端点,一个船长度相隔一圈,如何不同地推船. 一旦波浪逼近移动长度,生长速度就会放慢, ^rho在L=1.25 L=1.25时达到0.49 0.49. 反事实世界模型遵循 $\rho , 其估计误差几乎不变: 它的相对风险在 $ 0. 12 0. 12 至 0. 0. 0. 0. 0. 15 以上 , 大小从 0. 13 0. 13 至 0.64 0. 64 , 而训练有素的预测器则停留在 1. 11 1. 11 – 1. 17 1. 17 , 略高于 oracle 预测器而无结果 ( ). 在时间上, $\rho 停留在 0.020 0.020 – 0.022 0.022 , 反事实相对风险为 0.15 0.15 – 0.17 0.17 每个相位率: 某一事件的所有标题都在同一瞬间与字段相遇, 因此校正取决于当前各行动所导致位置的差异,而不是随时间的变化. 只有在一个过渡中观察到的残余物在以后的过渡中重新使用,一段时间后的变化才重要。 因此,残余再利用需要一种扰动,这种扰动在替代行动结果的距离上差别不大。 这些集合是诊断性的,因为神谕预测器已经达到86 86 — — 97 % — — 97 % — — R 2 R — — 2 % — — — ,而南北漂移的恢复略低于95% 95 — — ( ) 。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Residual reuse degrades as the current varies in space, not in time. Relative risk, i.e., summed squared position error over that of the oracle predictor without the outcome (dashed line), on the title-page boat as its eddies shrink (left, phase rate 0.3 0.3 radians per transition) and as their pattern drifts faster (right, L = 10 L=10 boat lengths). Residual reuse with exact conditional means estimates the interaction ratio ρ \rho ; the counterfactual world model adds a nearly constant estimation error to it, while the trained predictor (JEPA) stays above the oracle predictor. Gray marks the title-page current. Bars are bootstrap 95 % 95\% intervals over 1000 1000 fresh events with 16 16 alternative headings each. Diagnostic: the oracle predictor exceeds 60 % 60\% position R 2 R^{2} ( ).

blocks.en: Residual reuse needs coordinates in which actions and disturbances add, and raw pixels lack them even with exact means. On the title-page boat ( ) with a uniform current, for which correction after the readout is exact, we transport the observed outcome with Monte Carlo conditional means over the current, so no model is fitted and only the coordinates change. In pixels, the interaction ratio is 2.13 2.13 : the current displaces the boat’s edges, which lie elsewhere under the alternative heading, so adding the difference of mean images leaves a dark imprint and a blurred copy rather than a displaced boat. Read back through the frozen encoder and readout, these images give a relative risk of 5.86 5.86 against the true position, far worse than ignoring the outcome. The 768 768 MAE-B features are not additive in their own metric either ( ρ = 1.92 \rho=1.92 ), yet correction in feature space still carries the displacement into the readout (relative risk 0.31 0.31 ), and correction after the readout reaches 0.002 0.002 . Shorter transitions do not rescue pixels: their ratio stays between 1.74 1.74 and 2.18 2.18 from h = 1 h=1 to h = 0.05 h=0.05 ( ). Pixel intensities change sharply at the boat’s edges, so the second-order term of becomes small only for moves well below a pixel, and even at h = 0.05 h=0.05 the commanded move spans about 1.4 1.4 pixels. Counterfactual world models therefore reuse residuals in compact coordinates read out from a learned representation; a world model that predicts pixels would need such coordinates before its residual could be reused.
blocks.zh: 残余的再利用需要坐标,其中行动和扰动会增加,原始像素即使有确切的手段也缺乏这些坐标. 在标有统一电流的标题页船( ) 上, 读出后的校正是准确的, 我们用蒙特卡洛的有条件手段将观测到的结果运输到电流上, 因此没有安装模型, 只有坐标变化 。 在像素中,交互比为2.13 2.13 :电流取代了船的边缘,这些边缘位于其他标题下,因此加上平面图像的区别会留下暗印和模糊的复制品,而不是一个漂移的船. 通过冷冻编码器读回读出,这些图像给出了5.865.86相对真实位置的相对风险,远不如忽略结果. 768 768 MAE-B特性在其本身的度量中也不具有添加性(ρ = 1.92 \rho= 1.92),但在特征空间的校正中仍然带有置换到读取(相对风险0.31 0.31),读取到0.002 0.002之后的校正. 更短的过渡不保存像素 : 它们的比值在1.74 1.74和2.18 2.18之间,从h=1 h=1到h=0.05 h=0.05 ( ). 像素强度在船边变化很大,因此,只有远低于像素的移动,二阶期才变得很小,在h=0.05 h=0.05时,命令的移动跨度约为1.4 1.4 像素。 因此,反事实世界模型在紧凑坐标中再利用残余物从一个学到的表示中读出;一个预测像素的世界模型需要这样的坐标才能重新使用其残余物。

blocks.en: Push-T block velocities depend on whether the disturbed command produces contact. Their interaction ratios exceed one, and residual reuse with exact simulator means gives R 2 R^{2} values of 5.6 5.6 , − 15.5 -15.5 and − 44.4 % -44.4\% , below the references without the outcome at 20 20 – 39 % 39\% ( ). The failure is present before fitting a visual predictor.

The learned gain-fault experiment follows the interaction increase found in . At λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , correction in feature space reaches 70.5 70.5 – 70.6 % 70.6\% , above the oracle predictor without the outcome at 52.9 % 52.9\% . At λ = 1 \lambda=1 , it falls to 6.4 6.4 – 11.0 % 11.0\% , below the trained predictors at 41 41 – 42 % 42\% ; correction after the readout falls further, to between − 12.8 -12.8 and − 11.8 % -11.8\% ( and ). These λ > 0 \lambda>0 cells are diagnostic, since disturbance recovery from the frozen features falls below 95 % 95\% . A more accurate factual predictor cannot remove the interaction responsible for the exact-mean residual error. Complete physical checks, observability results and the uncertain-damping experiments are in and .
4.4  Planning with the Observed Outcome
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 与观察结果进行规划

blocks.en: Hindsight planning asks which command would have reached a goal in the event that just occurred, e.g., which heading would have brought the boat of to a mooring under the current it met. A retry, the correction of later commands under a persistent fault and the diagnosis of a failed attempt all need this answer; we test the first two below. We evaluate whether improved counterfactual predictions change the action selected for an observed event. After one factual transition, the planner receives a goal reached by another action under the same source state and disturbance. It selects a command, which we score by replaying that event. The goal is attainable by construction. The trained predictor and counterfactual model share the same frozen models, those of except on BlueROV2, which uses its 32 32 k-episode predictors; the oracle planners use the true simulator, either averaging over the disturbance law or observing the realized disturbance. All planners use the same cross-entropy search, except that on liquid transport the true-simulator planners use 16 16 candidates per round ( ). Success requires standardized distance to the goal below 0.2 0.2 ; full protocols are in .

blocks.en: The counterfactual world model succeeds in 35 35 – 69 % 69\% of events, compared with 9 9 – 25 % 25\% for the trained predictor and 14 14 – 23 % 23\% for the oracle planner without the outcome ( ). blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed counterfactual world models, which give world models a capability that
factual training cannot provide on its own, at the cost of two predictor calls
and one addition. The argument has one thread: individual counterfactuals
cannot be learned from unpaired data, physics supplies the missing structure
when disturbances enter through their own channel,
that structure dictates residual reuse, no estimator using unpaired data can
uniformly improve its rate, and the experiments confirm both its successes and
its failures. The rule is valid where the action–disturbance interaction is
small in the chosen representation, which
physics provides for force-like disturbances over short transitions and for
servoed setpoints once they settle: natura non facit saltus . Where nature
leaps, as through contacts, or where the disturbance scales the command instead
of adding its own force, the recipe fails, measurably.

blocks.en:
The residual carries the event, the world model carries the action. On
the boat of , the residual between the observed and predicted
positions is the drift caused by the current in this event; in HandReach, it is
the wrist offset produced by the miscalibrated servo; in BlueROV2, the pitch
change produced by the thruster offset. The world model supplies only how far the
change of command moves the system. Our benchmarks are calibrated so that the
disturbance carries about half of the counterfactual variance, which no
predictor that ignores the outcome can explain (oracle near 50 % 50\% ); on
HandReach, the same predictor explains 38.1 % 38.1\% without the residual and 85.6 % 85.6\% with it ( ). The remaining error has two sources, as in
( 16 ): the interaction, which no predictor can
remove, and the error of the learned action contrast, to which the readout adds

Ball-in-Cup, BlueROV2 and the Push-T pusher
( and ). On these coordinates, most of the gap
between the learned and the ideal counterfactual therefore comes from learning,
consistent with the gains from more factual data ( ).

blocks.en:
The operating window is set by the interaction, not by the clock. The
interaction ratio is the quantity to check. With exact factual predictions,
residual reuse beats the best predictor that ignores the outcome exactly when
this ratio is below one, which guarantees when the
interaction, scaled by the size of the action change, is small compared with how
strongly the disturbance moves the outcome. In our simulators, the ratio stays
well below one over one transition for every offset and external load of and , in coordinates without folds or
contacts, and it even decreases at longer durations once servos settle
( ). Gain faults keep it near two at every tested
duration, and contacts push it above one. Damping faults show where the window
closes for a disturbance that does enter through its own channel: they move the
outcome so little over these durations that their ratio stays at 0.74 0.74 – 1.08 1.08 ( ); for such weak disturbances, guarantees a ratio below one only over durations proportional to κ ​ σ \kappa\sigma ,
a window that narrows with the disturbance. The ratio itself needs paired
outcomes, so it is an evaluation diagnostic, not a quantity one can compute
from factual logs before deployment. Factual data can flag a large interaction,
such as a gain fault, which spreads the outcome more under larger commands, but
cannot certify a small one ( ); certifying a small
interaction on a new system needs another source: knowledge of where the disturbance enters, a
simulator, or paired trials under a disturbance that persists long enough to try
two actions.

blocks.en:
We now draw one consequence for each of the three fields this work connects:
world models, causal inference and control.
blocks.zh:

世界模型,因果推论和控制.

blocks.en:
For world models, a factual world model already contains a counterfactual
one. It takes two queries of the same predictor and the observed outcome. Its
accuracy is bounded by physics and approached by the factual world model: with
sixteen times more factual data, the same recipe moves the BlueROV2 underwater
vehicle from 73.6 73.6 to 93.5 % 93.5\% ( 94.1 % 94.1\% with seed ensembles), while the
trained predictor stays below the oracle predictor (no outcome). Accurate
counterfactuals need no paired data, latent disturbance model or extra
training, but they do need the observed outcome, coordinates in which the
response is near-additive, and features that determine the action response.
Generative likelihood, however good, does not supply the missing coupling
( ).

For causal inference, mechanics turns an identification assumption into
a physical one. For physical systems, the additive noise assumption that
identifies counterfactuals holds approximately when the action and the
disturbance enter through separate channels, with an explicit approximation rate
and explicit failure modes. The assumption concerns physical coordinates, such
as those read out from learned image features, and need not hold in the features
themselves: on the boat, MAE-B features give ρ = 1.92 \rho=1.92 ( ). The interaction ratio is a scale-free diagnostic of how
far a system is from the additive noise model in given coordinates
( ), measurable in simulation or from paired trials,
but not from factual logs alone.

blocks.en:
For control, classical disturbance estimators extend to learned image
world models. Disturbance observers, offset-free model predictive control and iterative learning
control are counterfactual estimators, usually analyzed with a known nominal
model, often a linear or linearized one [ 13 , 41 , 11 ] . Our
analysis extends their reasoning to nonlinear models learned on frozen image
features, at the price of an interaction term that is second order for force-like disturbances
and first order for multiplicative faults. In planning, the same construction
lets a frozen image world model (i) choose in hindsight better than the true
simulator without the outcome, (ii) correct a retried event, as iterative
learning control does, and (iii) reject a persistent fault, as offset-free
control does; when nothing persists, the transported residual is independent
of the next error and costs success ( ).

blocks.en:
Limitations. Residual reuse inherits four limits from its derivation.
First, it needs coordinates in which the effects of the action and the
disturbance add. A physical readout can provide them where raw pixels do not,
and even a readout fails where it folds, as cos ⁡ ( pitch ) \cos(\mathrm{pitch}) does
( ); a world model without a compact readout must first
find such coordinates. Fitting the readout needs physical-state labels on
factual frames; without them, correction in feature space keeps most of the
gain on four environments and about half of it on BlueROV2
( ). Second, it needs the disturbance to enter through its own
channel, the transition to avoid contacts, and the duration to keep the
interaction small; the failures of require the additional
information listed in . Third, it reuses one observed residual over
one transition. It does not chain counterfactuals over long horizons, and the
residual helps later decisions only when the disturbance persists
( ). Fourth, the predicted contrast must be causal: we
assume that the logged actions depended on nothing the world model does not see
( ), and leave logs from operators who perceived more
than was recorded for future work.

blocks.en:
Scope of the evidence. All environments are simulated, and their
disturbances are controlled actuator faults with stated physical meaning, not
exhaustive models of real-world uncertainty. Our scores concern prespecified
physical coordinates decoded from frozen frame embeddings, not full simulator
state or Markov sufficiency. The planning tasks use one-transition search, at
most three steps and goals in those coordinates, and the one-shot and retry
tasks score a hindsight decision by replaying the event in simulation. Two of
seven environments fail our criteria for recovering the scored quantities or the
disturbance from images ( ); BlueROV2 passes only with a
four times larger factual collection for its disturbance readout. The oracle
references of HandReach, Ball-in-Cup, FetchReach and BlueROV2 are Monte Carlo
estimates that agree with independent numerical refinements but carry no formal
numerical-error bound, and PassWater’s uses only four disturbance draws per
source state ( ).

blocks.en:
Open directions. Each limit suggests a direction. (i) The paired trials
above could tell, before deployment, where residual reuse is safe on a real
system. (ii) Since the error is set by the interaction in the chosen coordinates,
an encoder or readout could be trained, in simulation or from such trials, so
that actions and disturbances add, turning additivity from a property we check
into one we learn. (iii) Contacts and gain faults call for transport rules that
switch with the contact mode or rescale the residual with the command, combining
residual reuse with the other structures of . (iv) Factual error
over the whole feature vector is an imperfect proxy for the action contrast:
selecting the factual predictor by held-out error improves or preserves the
counterfactual in five of six environments but not on Push-T, and a criterion
targeted at the action response could close part of the gap left by learning.
(v) Chaining counterfactuals over several transitions, each with its own observed
outcome, would extend the uses that motivated counterfactual reasoning in
reinforcement learning, such as credit assignment, data augmentation and
explanation [ 33 , 47 , 60 ] ,
to learned world models of physical systems. Finally, the argument never uses
that the system is a robot: any process with smooth dynamics and a hidden
perturbation that enters through its own channel admits the same answer after a
surprise. We hope this study makes the
observed outcome a first-class input of world models, as offset-free control
has long made it for its own models.

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Protocol

blocks.en:
Each condition fixes the physics, query population, scored coordinates and
readouts before fitting. Qualification requires held-out disturbance and
retained-coordinate recovery of at least 95 % 95\% , and oracle (no outcome) and
factual-outcome-copy R 2 R^{2} strictly below 60 % 60\% on the same population;
simulation also checks true-state factual copying. A condition is qualified
only when every criterion has been measured and passes; an unmeasured criterion
leaves it unqualified. We call each criterion a gate ; conditions that
fail a gate are reported as diagnostics. Recovery is checked on held-out
factual episodes and on an independent confirmation cohort of new source states
collected after the physical setting was selected. A parent is a source
state from which the factual and all query branches are simulated with the
same disturbance draw; the scored source is the t = 2 t=2 anchor, reached after
two behavior-policy transitions. The numerical checks of the physical
references are reported separately in ( ).

The counterfactual experiments use frozen DINOv2-S and DINOv2-B [ 40 ] and MAE-B [ 23 ] , retaining their CLS
tokens (384, 768 and 768 coordinates, respectively). All receive bilinearly
resized full-frame 224 × 224 224\times 224 images, without center cropping, followed
by ImageNet channel normalization. This explicitly overrides the DINOv2
checkpoint’s default input size. No physical coordinate is concatenated with
the features. The encoder comparison of adds

each with its own channel normalization. The code release records model identifiers, checkpoint hashes,
normalization and pooling, and checks them at extraction and inference.

therefore especially limited. The other

retained. The shuffle control of replaces the
observed outcome by that of another disturbance draw of the same parent before
applying the correction. Reported aggregate physical R 2 R^{2} uses the summed squared errors and

paired whole-parent and fitting-seed bootstrap draws; the point estimate is
average single-fit risk, not the risk of an ensemble. These intervals

predictor (no outcome) is a Monte Carlo reference conditioned on the full
current simulator state and query action, without the current outcome or
disturbance; fresh disturbances make its conditional law independent of the
past. It uses more information than the image predictor, it is not the optimum
over image histories, and its intervals do not include numerical integration
error.

The reference arm in uses width 512, the t = 2 t=2 fitting
anchor and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The selected recipe minimizes the mean
held-out factual error over the seven data cells with MAE-B.
The development grid
uses MAE-B, seed zero and one frame on all seven data cells (BlueROV2 with its
level camera) and varies the training anchors (the t = 2 t=2 anchor only, or all
three recorded factual transitions of each fitting episode), AdamW weight decay
( 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 0.05 0.05 , 0.3 0.3 ) and predictor width ( 256 256 , 512 512 , 1,024 1{,}024 ; two
blocks), with validation every 100 updates. Validation episodes and anchors are
identical across the grid. The criterion is the mean over cells of the
held-out factual mean squared error in raw feature units, relative to the
reference recipe. Fitting all recorded transitions dominates every other factor
(held-out error 4 4 – 10 % 10\% lower than with the evaluation anchor alone, in
every completed cell), width 1,024 1{,}024 is best at every training scope, and
weight decay changes the criterion by less than 2 % 2\% . Over all seven cells,
the recipe with all transitions, width 1,024 1{,}024 and weight decay 0.3 0.3 has the
lowest mean relative error ( 0.931 0.931 ), ahead of weight decays 0.05 0.05 ( 0.933 0.933 )
and 10 − 4 10^{-4} ( 0.934 0.934 ) at the same width, with the largest gains on BlueROV2
and Racetrack ( 0.89 0.89 and 0.90 0.90 ). This grid is a separate development run:
its reference fits use seed zero and validate every 100 updates, whereas the orig. arm of reports the original three-seed fits,
so its factual gains differ from these relative errors. The final refits were launched with this
recipe once it led on every completed cell and were confirmed when the
remaining width- 1,024 1{,}024 and reference cells finished; 30 30 of the 126 126 grid
fits (narrower widths and the anchor-only scope on four cells, worse on every
cell where they completed) were not run to completion. Every arm validates on
held-out factual episodes at the t = 2 t=2 anchor, the anchor at which
counterfactuals are evaluated, so selection sees source states drawn like the
evaluation ones but only their factual outcomes.

For 16 16 fresh events and eight alternative headings each, conditional means over the current average 32 32 draws shared by all headings, and a duration h h scales both the commanded move and the current. blocks.en:
Each
independent episode starts from the declared native reset law and runs two
actual disturbed policy transitions before the anchor. Policies are the
HandReach inverse-kinematics controller, a Ball-in-Cup policy pretrained with deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG),
the FetchReach reach controller, a Racetrack lane follower, the BlueROV2 goal
controller, the PassWater water-transport controller and a pretrained Push-T
diffusion policy, with the declared exploration. At the
anchor the factual command is independently uniform over the fixed support, and
evaluation uses the same factual-command law and three independent uniform query
commands. No equal-action reconstruction row enters a CF score, and no difficult
contact, terminal or small-action case is removed to improve a score; terminal
handling follows the declared absorbing convention.

blocks.en:

the identical complete simulator snapshot and reusing the realized offset occur
only in evaluation. Rendering is isolated by native replay, so refreshing
renderer kinematics cannot change a subsequent behavior command. Recorded prefix
states, commands, disturbances and endpoints are checked against the independent
evaluation sampler. State labels remain private to calibration, replay checks and
evaluation-head fitting; the world predictor sees only frozen frame embeddings
and observed commands. The BlueROV2 camera change ( ) affects observation geometry only,
and verifies that its factual state/action/disturbance arrays are unchanged.

each lateral integration substep, lane boundaries, and separation from the
retained traffic vehicle over all current disturbance values. Monotone
Gaussian-bin enclosures give a confirmation R 2 R^{2} error bound of .002697 .002697 , and
native endpoint agreement is within 2.85 × 10 − 14 2.85\times 10^{-14} . These bounds include
conservative floating-point padding, not formal verification of numerical
libraries. The PassWater coordinate is glass position; native fluid motion is
present but not the checked output. Its task controller improves transport
distance while retaining 99.8845 % 99.8845\% of the water, versus 99.9784 % 99.9784\% for uniform
commands. None of these restricted results establishes additive block-contact,
fluid-particle or image-embedding dynamics.

Humanoid/DINOv2 retains a 2 × 2 2\times 2 patch grid; the other image
features are globally pooled. PushT/DINOv2 uses 16 context frames and five
concatenated controls per macro-step. OGBench uses the official visual stitch corpora, stitch-val report episodes and registered
third-person camera; PushT uses push-t.lance , reserving 20% of its training split for
validation after the 80% train split.
The action-concatenating MLP uses SiLU, LayerNorm and three width-1,024
hidden layers (two for maze V-JEPA 2). AdamW uses zero weight decay, gradient
clipping at 1 and bfloat16 precision. Linear warmup spans 5% of the stage
(0.5% for final temporal PushT stages), followed by cosine decay to 1% of
the peak learning rate. Maze DINOv2 and V-JEPA 2 use peak rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} and batch/device 32/16 (AntMaze/Humanoid DINOv2) or 8
(V-JEPA 2); PushT/DINOv2 uses 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} and batch/device 2.
Final-stage budgets are one epoch and can resume earlier fits. Training uses
stable-pretraining, like the benchmark predictors; seeds and the exact training
history accompany the code release.

Each of the 1000 1000 fresh evaluation events is scored at 16 16 alternative headings, every 22.5 ∘ 22.5^{\circ} .
